scientific_contract.selector_equality: Pion < 0.01 -> HMLA; equality belongs to SWIFT path when active-temperature gate passes

required_execution: reproduce frozen hillipop-ede_n3 background H(z), H'(z), nH(z)
initialize exact HyRec tables and fit_swift.dat
evaluate rec_HMLA_dxHIIdlna and rec_swift_hyrec_dxHIIdlna on identical F=0 states for both q branches
compute outward/interval bounds for N_HMLA and N_SWIFT over full reachable surface coverage
refine every zero/ambiguous cell; preserve unresolved cells
emit coverage manifest and source hashes
accept: all reachable cells certified compatible/crossing, or all unresolved cells certified unreachable
reject: validated reachable cell/segment with incompatible one-sided normals sufficient to obstruct requested continuation
inconclusive: any reachable sign-ambiguous cell or unavailable frozen dependency
